summary: XPENG is chinese automobile manufacturer, founded in 2014. Type: listed company. About 13,550 employees (Wikidata). Revenue renminbi 40.9 billion (2024). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 9 about funding; 6 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Chinese electric car maker whose European holding in Diemen is an IND recognised sponsor, recruiting graduates for an entry-level role mentioning visas.

culture.text: Its graduate role targets recent Bachelor's or Master's grads who take initiative and are comfortable with fast change.
Large company: 13,550 employees in 2023, headquartered in Guangzhou, China.

open.text: XPeng European Holding B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, an entry-level role in Diemen, needs no Dutch and mentions visas; it drew 200 LinkedIn applicants on average.

growth.text: Revenue was 40.9 billion renminbi in 2024, with a net loss of 5.8 billion renminbi.
Delivered 41,256 vehicles in September 2026, its highest month of the year, though slightly down year on year.
Signed Emil Frey as a German dealer in a push toward 110 sites, and is launching the G9L SUV to speed up European expansion.

worth_knowing.text: Reportedly consolidating product lines to cut R&D costs.
